_comment: USD per million tokens. Keys are lowercase model ids or prefixes (longest prefix wins). Override with GM_BENCH_PRICING=<path>. Anthropic prices verified 2026-06-24; OpenAI prices verified 2026-07-04; Gemini prices verified 2026-07-11; TypeSafe jev launch price ($0.042 input, $0 output, described as possibly subsidized) recorded 2026-09-18 from launch coverage and matched the same day against OpenRouter's gateway-billed cost for a 580-call panel (input-only; reported output tokens billed at zero). GPT-6 Luna and Sol (Standard processing, short-context rates) verified 2026-09-23 against https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing and the model pages developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-6-luna and gpt-6-sol (openai.com/api/pricing answered 403 to a scripted fetch that day); the model pages say prompts with more than 272K input tokens are priced at 2x input and cache rates and 1.5x output for the full request, recorded as long_context_input_tokens. GPT-5.6 Terra and Luna corrected 2026-09-23 from their model pages (were $2.50/$15 and $1/$6; now $2/$12 and $0.20/$1.20, cached $0.20 and $0.02, cache writes 1.25x input, same 272K tier). GPT-5.6 Sol is deliberately left at $5/$30: its model page lists $4/$20 as promotional pricing available at least through 2026-11-21, and this table pins undiscounted list rates. Claude Sonnet 5 corrected 2026-09-23 from https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing (was $3/$15; now $2 input, $10 output, $0.20 cache hits, $2.50 5-minute cache writes; the full 1M context is at standard pricing, so no long-context tier); its $4 1-hour cache-write rate (2x input) added 2026-09-24 from the same page. Optional fields, all USD per million tokens unless named otherwise: cached_input_per_mtok (cache-read rate), cache_write_per_mtok (cache-write rate; Anthropic's 5-minute tier), cache_write_1h_per_mtok (Anthropic's 1-hour cache-write rate; falls back to cache_write_per_mtok), long_context_input_tokens (per-request input size above which a long-context tier applies), verified (date the entry was checked). estimate_cost_usd reads only input_per_mtok and output_per_mtok; the optional fields feed api_equivalent_cost_usd. Unknown models yield cost_usd=null, never a guess.
